हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Rejected, insulted, and treated like a nobody, Samay hides his true identity as the mysterious King Maker. But when the truth comes out at a grand public event, the same people who mocked him are forced to bow before him.
